record.original_question: Find necessary and sufficient conditions on a compact space X for the product ω × X to have remote points in its Stone–Čech remainder, where a remote point is a point of βY − Y that is not in the closure of any nowhere dense subset of Y.

evidence.quote: Question 2. Find necessary and suﬃcient conditions on a compact space X so that ω × X has remote points.
A remote point is a point of βX − X which is not in the closure of any nowhere dense subset of X.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $\omega$ denote the countably infinite discrete space of natural numbers, and let all spaces be Tychonoff. For a space $Y$, let $\beta Y$ denote its Stone–Čech compactification. A point $p \in \beta Y \setminus Y$ is called a remote point of $Y$ if $p \notin \overline{N}^{\beta Y}$ for every nowhere dense subset $N \subseteq Y$.

Find necessary and sufficient conditions on a compact Hausdorff space $X$ such that the product space $\omega \times X$ admits a remote point, i.e., such that there exists a point in $\beta(\omega \times X) \setminus (\omega \times X)$ that lies in the closure of no nowhere dense subset of $\omega \times X$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem of characterizing compact spaces X for which ω × X has remote points is a classical question in βX-theory. Partial results exist: van Douwen and (independently) Chae–Smith showed every non-pseudocompact space of countable π-weight has a remote point, and work by Dow and others (e.g., "Remote points in large products") addresses sufficient conditions. No definitive necessary-and-sufficient characterization for arbitrary compact X was located in the search.

status_evidence.title: Remote point - Wikipedia
status_evidence.snippet: van Douwen, and independently Chae and Smith, have shown that each non-pseudocompact space of countable π-weight has a remote point.
status_evidence.claim: Sufficient conditions for the existence of remote points are known, but a full characterization for ω × X with X compact does not appear to be established.

status_evidence.title: Remote points in large products
status_evidence.snippet: Remote points in large products (Topology and its Applications).
status_evidence.claim: Continued research on remote points in product spaces indicates the question remains an active topic rather than fully resolved.
